comps.label: C1
comps.reason: Direct-to-consumer cash advance and neobank app funded on its own book; no institutional capital network or lender-facing AI platform.

comps.label: C2
comps.reason: Buys and collects defaulted receivables; a distressed-debt recovery business, not AI origination and funding of new consumer credit.

comps.label: C3
comps.reason: Pawn lending and used goods retail through physical stores; different model, customers and products from an AI lending network.

comps.label: C4
comps.reason: Defaulted debt purchaser and collector; different business from originating and placing new loans with institutional investors.

comps.label: C5
comps.reason: Tech-driven point-of-sale consumer financing through merchant partners, sharing Pagaya's POS financing and B2B partner model, though it holds balance sheet exposure.
